title: 大观园 Beijing, China (25435155793).jpg
changes: None; unmodified original bytes verified against Commons imageinfo SHA-1.
visual_review: The visible plaque reads 秋爽齋 from right to left. The close entrance view shows a red structural frame, green rectangular return-pattern door lattices and a blue/turquoise/yellow painted upper beam and open fretwork. It supports the study hall frontage and patterned screen treatment; the cropped view does not establish the complete roof, plan, dimensions or the required night lighting.

scope: Collected painted-scroll material reference; not a shipped production texture.
visual_review: The original ink-on-silk hanging scroll shows grouped tapered bamboo leaves, articulated stalks, varied wet/dry ink density, calligraphic marks and visible warm silk weave. It provides a close painted-scroll material and brush-treatment reference for the study's bamboo scroll. It is not a photograph of Qiushuang architecture, a botanical model, measured pigment values or evidence of night lighting.
